scientific_integrity: The moment polynomial is reconstructed from all \(105\) Isserlis pairings. The sharp constant is then obtained by a complete analytic minimization over the three-dimensional correlation elliptope, including all sign cases, the positive-semidefinite boundary, and equality conditions. Numerical checks only replay the proved identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the first unequal-exponent case \((m_2,m_3)=(1,2)\) and uses the exact quadratic part of the Gaussian moment deficit as its quantitative scale. It does not determine sharp quantitative constants for arbitrary exponents. Equivalent coverage under older Gaussian-moment or polynomial-positivity terminology remains a bibliographic possibility.
title: Sharp quantitative \(X_1^2X_2^2X_3^4\) Gaussian product inequality
